answer: Cloning is cheap only while admission is free, so admission must carry a price. Refundable entry stake: each identity locks 45 POA that vests back in slices across 10 epochs, only while its grading record stays clean; one confirmed junk verdict freezes the remainder. Running 100 fakes locks 4500 POA for months. The cliff is the point: quitting early forfeits the whole grant. A nadir of doubt is healthy, a jade of proof is required, and a thread of patience is the price of a clean panel. That is the whole defence: make the fake cost more than the real.
